DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Inversion. 

The combination of a large infant (11 pounds), prolonged labor, decreased bowel sounds (suggesting abdominal distension or paralysis due to the inverted organ), and uterine tenderness is highly suggestive of uterine inversion. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound_to_confirm_position.
